h:
They say the serpent in Eden was a liberator. That Jesus and Lucifer are the same. That YHWH is the villain.

This isn't edgy "hidden truth," it's the oldest lie in the book. Let’s expose it, incinerate it, and reestablish the Kingdom order.

"Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness." — Isaiah 5:20

The Viral Lie Returns

It slithers across screens, podcasts, YouTube commentaries, and spiritual influencers’ feeds. It parades itself as academic, edgy, and forbidden wisdom, "truth the early church didn’t want you to know."

It wears the costume of mystery:

  • "Ancient secrets of Eden"
  • "The Gnostic gospels revealed"
  • "Why the serpent was actually the hero"

But its most brazen mutation?

"The serpent in the Garden of Eden… was actually Jesus."

No. Absolutely not. That isn’t revelation. It’s Luciferian inversion. The theological equivalent of treason against the Most High.

It’s not new. It’s the original hiss. The same propaganda war the serpent started in Eden.

Light the Lie on Fire

This claim traces back to The Testimony of Truth, a Gnostic text within the Nag Hammadi collection, unearthed in Egypt in 1945.

Some claim these writings were "banned" to suppress secret knowledge. False. They were rejected by the early Ekklesia because they twisted the truth into heresy.

This text pushes the core of the serpent’s doctrine:

  • That the serpent was the misunderstood liberator
  • That YHWH is an oppressive jailer
  • That a rogue "Savior" came to free us from His rule

This isn’t spiritual insight. It’s sabotage. A cosmic coup d’état.

Let’s call it what it is:

  • YHWH is replaced by the serpent
  • Yeshua is replaced by Lucifer
  • Humanity is cast as autonomous "gods" with no covenant

This isn’t theology. It’s blasphemous theater. And it needs to be burned down.

The Original Lie: "You Can Be Your Own God"

Genesis 3 doesn’t require arcane insight, it’s blunt and surgical.

"Now the serpent was more cunning than any beast of the field which YHWH Elohim had made." — Genesis 3:1

Cunning. Not divine.

The serpent didn’t offer wisdom. He twisted the Word. He baited Eve with counterfeit power:

"You will not surely die... your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God..." - Genesis 3:4-5

That same lie echoes today:

  • New Age mantras
  • Gnostic texts
  • Eastern mysticism
  • Hyper-charismatic lawless teachings
  • Techno-religions of self-divinity

Different packaging. Same poison:

You can be your own god.

Gnosticism: The System of the Serpent

Gnosticism isn’t just wrong. It’s war. It’s the serpent’s worldview disguised in spiritual jargon and pseudo-wisdom.

At its root, Gnosticism is:

  • Anti-Torah
  • Anti-YHWH
  • Anti-Christ (even when it falsely uses His name)

It offers mystery instead of obedience, and inversion instead of alignment. Every Kingdom truth is reversed.

Kingdom Truth vs Gnostic Inversion

  • YHWH is the Most High. Gnosticism claims YHWH is a false, lesser “Demiurge.”
  • The serpent is Satan. Gnosticism claims the serpent is an agent of enlightenment.
  • Jesus is Torah made flesh. Gnosticism claims Jesus is a mystical rebel sent to liberate us from Torah.
  • Sin is rebellion against YHWH. Gnosticism claims sin is actually submission to an oppressive deity.
  • Man is dust + breath, made in His image. Gnosticism claims man is a trapped divine spark imprisoned in matter.

This isn’t just error. It’s insurgency. A theological coup designed to dethrone the King.

Why the Early Church Fought Gnosticism

Gnosticism didn’t rise centuries later, it was active during the apostolic era.

John fires a direct shot:

"Every spirit that does not confess that Yeshua has come in the flesh is not of God. This is the spirit of the Antichrist..." — 1 John 4:3

Gnostics taught:

  • Yeshua didn’t come in the flesh
  • He opposed Torah
  • He was disconnected from the Creator

It fractures the Son from the Father. It swaps obedience for "gnosis."

The early Ekklesia didn’t suppress gnostic texts. They deleted malware from the mainframe.

This War Is About Loyalty, Not Secrets

Gnosticism lures you with secret knowledge. The Kingdom calls you to visible allegiance.

YHWH doesn’t speak in riddles to His children. He speaks covenant.

"Choose this day whom you will serve..." — Joshua 24:15

You don’t need:

  • Hidden scrolls
  • Forbidden codes
  • Mystical formulas

You need:

  • Repentance
  • Covenant
  • Obedience

The serpent always sells shortcuts. But they always lead to death.

Different robes. Same hiss.

Guard the Garden of Your Mind

You are the temple now. Eden is your model.

Adam didn’t fall because he was uninformed. He fell because he didn’t guard.

Your mind is a battlefield. Your theology is soil. Protect it like Eden.

Kingdom protocol:

  • Protect what is holy. Your mind, your beliefs, your covenant
  • Enforce sacred boundaries. Don’t tolerate serpent doctrine
  • Expel unauthorized voices. Remove false teachers and demonic counsel

Don’t call deception “depth.” Don’t rename rebellion “revelation.”

Close the gate.

Kingdom Execution Steps

  • Audit your intake If it questions YHWH’s authority or Torah’s design. Cut it off.
  • Master Genesis 1-3 Learn it line by line. Every heresy starts with twisting these verses.
  • Call the serpent by name Don’t flirt with heresy. Expose it. Name it. Reject it.
  • Declare allegiance daily Speak it out loud: “I belong to YHWH. I obey His Word. Yeshua is Messiah.”
  • Equip others Train the remnant. Don’t let the next generation sip serpent wine.
  • Confront false teaching Whether online or in the assembly, don’t stay silent. Light it up.
  • Practice covenant discipline Fast. Pray. Obey. Let your life match your confession.

Final Word

The serpent wasn’t Jesus.
Jesus wasn’t rebelling against YHWH. He was fulfilling the will of the Father.

He didn’t quote the serpent.
He crushed him.

He didn’t promise divinity through self.
He demanded death to self.

He didn’t liberate you from the Law.
He wrote it on your heart.

Don’t sip the serpent’s gospel and call it wisdom.
Don’t rebrand Eden’s rebellion as awakening.

This is a war of seeds.

You either serve the serpent or serve the King.

Choose your lineage.
